sections.preflight: Branch claude/ssangyong-autos-redesign-8isn7d on othoth77/mythos-prod; clean tree at 5663a43. Critical fact surfaced before work: TWO systems named ssangyong.autos — the frozen legacy apex site (/var/www/ssangyong.autos, migration-plan §21, NEVER touched) and the ratified §22-option-3 storefront in projects/ssangyong-autos/reference/ (decided hostname store.ssangyong.autos). The redesign targets the storefront ONLY. Known P0: BLOCKER-SYA-API-DOWN (user unit 218/CAPABILITIES) — production deployment is a host step regardless.
sections.status_center: UNREACHABLE — *.mythosprod.xyz blocked by the Claude Code environment network policy; task recorded via pending-task-imports per contract.
sections.search_first: Verdict: EXTEND. Reused and extended the repo's own SYA-SHOP-1 storefront (no-framework, CSP-hardened, tested) and the MYTHOS design-system architecture (docs/design/DESIGN_TOKENS.md — 3 tiers, 4px scale, measured contrast). External storefronts evaluated per the mission (Saleor/Reaction/React auto-parts): REJECTED for adoption — React/Next build stacks contradict the repository's no-build convention and are grossly oversized for a 346-product read-only catalog; only their UX patterns (PLP filters, vehicle fitment flow, empty-state recovery) were adapted. No new dependency added (playwright-core used only as session-local validation tooling, not committed).
sections.capabilities: Storefront views: home (hero with 3 discovery modes: vehicle finder / OEM reference / browse; model cards; brand strip; trust blocks; assistance CTA), catalogue PLP (vehicle+availability+brand filters, sort whitelist, grid/list toggle, mobile filter drawer, empty state with recovery actions), product page (buy panel, OE refs, specs, fitment table with data-backed 'Compatible avec votre véhicule' badge via ?model/?motor context), models view, assistance view. API additive: GET /api/availabilities, ?availability=, ?sort= (reference|price_asc|price_desc|recent; default unchanged). WhatsApp fully architected but GATED behind CONTACT.whatsapp='' — no number exists in the repo, none invented (mission rule 28); owner sets one constant to activate every CTA with prefilled context. No category tree — schema.sql §6 holds; discovery is vehicle-first + OEM + brand, which the data truly supports.
sections.changes: projects/ssangyong-autos/reference/shop.html (rewritten), shop.css (rewritten — SYA design tokens branched from MYTHOS architecture: technical slate + signal orange, light-first, a11y/contrast-measured), shop-ui.js (rewritten — view router, gated WhatsApp, fit badge, drawer, image-error fallback), api.js (additive sort/availability/facet), tests/sya-shop-1-storefront-test.js (contract grown 39→52 checks, all security guarantees kept + WhatsApp-gate and no-invented-number checks added), tests/sya-api-1-readonly-catalog-api-test.js (60→68 checks), projects/ssangyong-autos/README.md, docs/AI_HANDOVER.md.
sections.git: Committed and pushed to claude/ssangyong-autos-redesign-8isn7d; draft PR opened on othoth77/mythos-prod. No force push, no history rewrite, legacy site untouched, no data deleted.
sections.validation: REAL-DATA validation inside the session: local PostgreSQL 16 cluster built from the committed schema.sql + migration/import.sql (346 products / 17 models / 63 motorizations / 782 compatibility / 311 images; validation.sql 18/18). Suites against it: sya-api-1 68/0; sya-shop-2 (storefront) 52/0. Real Chromium (Playwright) drive at 390px and 1440px: home, catalogue, vehicle-filtered catalogue, product (fit-badge context), models, assistance, mobile filter drawer — no console errors except sandbox-egress blocks of autopart.tn images (production CSP allows that origin; a new image-error fallback degrades to the neutral 'Photo non disponible' state). node --check clean on all JS.
sections.deployment: NOT PERFORMED — impossible from this environment and a host step by design (§22 option 3 + SYA-DEPLOY-1). Host order: (1) fix/start the storefront service — the P0 218/CAPABILITIES user-unit blocker predates this task; (2) git pull; (3) sudo bash scripts/deploy-sya-storefront.sh → store.ssangyong.autos (NEVER the apex); (4) certbot; (5) verify / , ?view=cat, ?p=<uid>, /api/health through nginx. The apex https://ssangyong.autos (legacy, frozen) remains untouched and unaffected.
sections.problems: 1) WhatsApp number: none exists in the repository — CTAs ship hidden until the owner sets CONTACT.whatsapp in shop-ui.js (one constant). 2) Product images blocked by this sandbox's egress proxy — cosmetic here only. 3) Deployment + service-unit P0 fix are host steps (recorded, not silently skipped). 4) Mission sections requiring data the catalog does not hold (categories tree, promotions, prices/stock beyond scraped values) were implemented as honest neutral states or omitted per the mission's own rule 28, not faked.
sections.outcome: Implementation COMPLETE and validated against the real catalog; task BLOCKED at DEPLOYMENT because production deploy/verify is executable only on the host. Definition-of-done items achievable in-environment are all done; the remaining checklist items (deployment verified, public URL functional) transfer to the host TODO in docs/AI_HANDOVER.md.
